newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan fund guaranteed $1.79 bln projects.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan fund guaranteed $1.79 bln projects.

text.p: Morocco's Caisse Centrale de Garantie (CCG) had provided guarantees for 1,486 projects worth 16 billion dirhams ($1.79 billion) over a 22-year period, of which 52 percent was in foreign currency, a finance ministry official said on Friday.
A statement sent to Reuters said the Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj attended the CCG meeting held the previous day.
The state-owned fund's function is to provide guarantees for companies wishing to obtain loans, mobilise foreign capital and develop exports, the statement said.
Of those projects supported by the fund 31 percent were in industry, 24 percent in fisheries, 19 percent in communications and 11 percent in energy and agriculture. ($1= 8.9 dirhams)
